author: ninjaniall72
body:
I am aware that i have been banned and would like to be un banned if at all possible. I have shared this account with a friend for up until march this year and understand that he has broken one of your rules. He is not using my account anymore and I would like to plea to be un banned for his mistakes. I offer my services to help with anything you need like mods or admins as i believe that minecraft should be fair for everyone and want to reverse my friends wrong doing. If you could reply promptly that would be great as your server is the best nebular server. I would love to enjoy playing on your server again and help enforce the rules.

best regards,
ninjaniall72

replies.body:
Hey ninjaniall72,

Since you have been banned for quite a while I have decided to give you another chance and appeal your ban.
Please update yourself with the rules as they may have changed a bit since your last time on avicus. 

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie :: Senior Moderator
